Logic - if two dice have the same face value in the given image than their clockwise or anticlockwise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

As 4 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 2,3,5,6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 1 will be opposite to it.

Opposite pairs

2 = 5

3 =6

1 = 4
